description: This Java class handles approval commands for fixed deposit account applications within the Fineract project. It processes approval commands by invoking the relevant service to approve fixed deposit applications.

classes.name: FixedDepositAccountApplicationApprovalCommandHandler
classes.description: Handles approval command for fixed deposit accounts, integrating with the deposit application service to approve fixed deposit applications.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the approval command, delegating to the deposit application service to approve the application with provided command data.
